title: Business constraints — Peak take-home
shortDescription: The Peak assessment brief, its submission rules and evaluation criteria, and the hard technical rules Zac has adopted as binding.

title: Biomarker history
shortDescription: What members get from the biomarker history chart, what their data looks like, and the known gaps (screen-reader equivalent, one-sided bands, unit changes).

title: ADR-0001: Partitioned document store is the only persistence
shortDescription: All persistence goes through Store's frozen pk/sk API with no indexes; documents the current key layout and what it makes cheap or expensive.

title: ADR-0002: Draw results keep the ranges and status they had when drawn
shortDescription: Each stored biomarker result carries its own status and reference ranges as at the draw; ingest classifies against current definitions and merges by biomarker ID.

title: ADR-0003: Biomarker history is fetched on demand from its own endpoint
shortDescription: GET /api/biomarkers/{id}/history serves one biomarker's history lazily; /api/home carries only latest values. Includes the measured per-draw cost of growing home.

title: ADR-0004: History charts plot each point against its own as-at-draw ranges
shortDescription: Biomarker history charts draw stepped reference bands from each draw's stored ranges and show stored status; nothing is reclassified against the current catalogue.

title: C4 context and containers
shortDescription: Who uses the Peak member dashboard, which external systems feed it, and its single-process FastAPI + vanilla JS + SQLite-backed store shape.

title: Project structure
shortDescription: Where code, client, seed data, scripts and tests live in the Peak dashboard repo, and how to run, test, lint and benchmark it.
